messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the last postmortem — I want a short, owned tracker for the GPU capacity/autoscale fixes. Can we list owners + target dates here?

devon: I can start the tracker. TL;DR: quota bump, scheduler tweaks, headroom plan, and canary scaling rules.

arkady: For scheduler tuning — I want to validate podPriority+preempt logic before changing thresholds. ETA for tests: 3 working days.

li: I’ll own quota requests to cloud provider (requesting additional spare GPUs for headroom). Target submit: EOD Tue, approval window 5 business days.

sre-bot: Incident summary: peak GPU utilization 97% for 12m, autoscaler delayed 90s due to scale-up cooldown.

maria: OK, rough plan (short list):
1) Quota request (owner: li) — submit Tue, track approvals
2) Scheduler threshold tests (owner: arkady) — 3d test -> PR to staging
3) Canary autoscale policy (owner: devon) — implement decoupled burst pool + fallback model
4) Headroom cost calc & budget (owner: sophie) — provide monthly numbers

maria: Please add explicit acceptance criteria for each item (how we know it's done).

devon: Acceptance for canary autoscale:
- automated canary run for 4 hours with synthetic load
- no request latency > 2s p95
- fallback to smaller model successful within 30s
I’ll open a tiny playbook in the repo.

arkady: Scheduler tests acceptance:
- reproduce delayed preemption in staging with 2x burst jobs
- tuning does not increase eviction rate by >1%
- metrics instrumentation added to tracing dashboard
I’ll post test logs to the ops-runbook channel.

li: Quota acceptance: provider approves requested spare GPUs OR we have a documented fallback plan (reserved spot + billing contact).

sophie: Headroom acceptance: validated cost delta < 12% vs current baseline and a handoff doc to finance. I’ll put numbers in a spreadsheet and link here.

maria: timeline proposal: li submit Tue, arkady tests finish Fri, devon canary by next Wed, sophie budget with finance by next Thu. Can people flag blockers now?

devon: blocker: need an automated synthetic load script for canary. I can adapt the bench harness but need access to staging model endpoints. @maria can you grant?

maria: Granted. I’ll add you to the staging service account.

arkady: blocker: we need a staging cluster with same preemption config. Ops infra will provision, 24–48h.

li: cloud quotas sometimes need _technical_ justification doc. I’ll draft and ping platform security for sign-off.

sophie: finance needs the baseline token/sec numbers — I’ll pull them and attach in spreadsheet.

maria: Nice. One more operational action: we should add a recurring 15m weekly sync for 6 weeks to watch patterns after changes. Owner: maria. First sync next Mon 11:00 PST.

devon: added to my calendar. I’ll create the tracker board and post link here when ready.

arkady: I’ll push a stub PR with test harness by EOD Thu.

li: Quota request drafted, will submit Tue morning and attach request id here.

sre-bot: Reminder: create post-change alert rule for autoscale lag > 60s so we catch regressions early.

maria: Great. Everyone, drop short status updates in this thread only (not new threads) so we can fold into the remediation checklist. I’ll compile final owner/timeline table and pin it in the incident channel. :thumbsup:
